verdict.rationale: Crossplane is self-hosted control-plane software, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any way to disable them. The documented feature flags (alpha features off by default, realtime compositions, signature verification) are unrelated controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
